runs.name: q1-mainsnap-load
runs.description: main aadc3f8's snapshot (96-word cells, 224-word genomes) loads into Q1 with the signal off

evals.js: return JSON.stringify({q1: moire.signals.params.on, notes: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.notes, exact: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.exact, rounding: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.rounding, sig: moire.signals.ledger})

runs.name: q1-oldsnap
runs.description: an old snapshot (tissue lab) loads with the signal off

evals.js: return JSON.stringify({q1: moire.signals.params.on, notes: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.notes.filter(n => n.includes('Q1'))})

runs.name: q1-selfsnap-load
runs.description: a Q1 snapshot (a puff in the water) reloads with its signal

evals.js: return JSON.stringify({q1: moire.signals.params.on, notes: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.notes, exact: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.exact, rounding: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.rounding, sig: moire.signals.ledger})
